chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Abī Najrān, from Muthannā al-Ḥannāṭ, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the fornicator when the prescribed punishment has been administered to him. He said: “He is banished from the land to which he goes to another town, where he remains for one year.”

key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator; the person guilty of zina
key_terms.بَلْدَةٍ: a town or locality to which he is sent
key_terms.جُلِدَ: was flogged; had the corporal punishment administered

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on banishment for a fornicator after the hadd punishment in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the fornicator after the hadd punishment has been carried out. It indicates that, in addition to flogging, he is to be exiled from his land to another town for one year.
